info_recording: Recording mouse and keyboard input. Use the shortcut to stop.
hint_coordinates: Pick on screen or enter manually
msg_tray_unavailable: System tray unavailable; closing the window will quit Otoshi.
msg_ui_error: An unexpected error occurred. See the log file for details.
msg_hotkeys_failed: Could not register {hotkeys}. Choose other hotkeys in Settings.
msg_no_macro: There is no macro to play. Record or open one first.
already_running: Otoshi is already running. Open it from the system tray icon.
tray_hint: Otoshi is running in the background. Shortcuts remain active.
picker_cancel: Press Esc or right-click to cancel
err_speed_number: Speed must be a number, e.g. 1.5x.
hk_err_unsupported: {key} cannot be used as a hotkey.
hk_err_modifier_only: Add a regular key to the modifier (for example Ctrl+F2).
hk_err_typing: A single typing key would fire while you type. Use an F-key or add a modifier.
hk_err_f12: Windows reserves F12. Add a modifier or choose another key.
hk_err_in_use: {hotkey} is already used by another program.
mf_too_large: The file is too large to be an Otoshi macro.
mf_not_macro: This is not an Otoshi macro file.
mf_newer: This macro was saved by a newer Otoshi version.
mf_empty: The macro file contains no playable events.
mf_legacy_unsafe: This old-format macro file could not be read safely.
desc_overlay: Shows the active mode in a screen corner
desc_close_to_tray: Keep running in the background when the window is closed
desc_hotkeys: Available even when Otoshi is in the background
page_macro_desc: Record and play back mouse and keyboard input
page_clicker_desc: Click automatically at a set interval
desc_humanize: Adds small variations to timing and click position
hint_humanize_pos: Maximum deviation of the click position
hint_interval_max: When set, the interval is randomized up to this value
hint_hold_key: Click, then press the key to hold
msg_hold_key_is_hotkey: {hotkey} is an Otoshi hotkey and cannot be held.
desc_start_with_windows: Start Otoshi automatically when you sign in
desc_start_in_tray: Start in the system tray without showing the window
desc_finish_sound: Play a sound when a task finishes
desc_finish_notification: Show a Windows notification when a task finishes
msg_autostart_failed: Could not change the Windows startup setting.
macro_hint: Start a recording ({hotkey}) or open a saved macro.
desc_reset_defaults: Restores every setting except the language
